name: gatherly
description: AI-powered event planning and management platform

scripts.setup: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const cmd = isWin ? 'powershell' : 'bash'; const args = isWin ? ['-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', './scripts/setup-hooks.ps1'] : ['./scripts/setup-hooks.sh']; const res = spawnSync(cmd, args, { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(res.status || 0);"
scripts.pull: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const cmd = isWin ? 'powershell' : 'bash'; const args = isWin ? ['-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', './scripts/pull.ps1'] : ['./scripts/pull.sh']; const res = spawnSync(cmd, args, { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(res.status || 0);"
scripts.sync-log: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const cmd = isWin ? 'powershell' : 'bash'; const args = isWin ? ['-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', './scripts/sync-log.ps1'] : ['./scripts/sync-log.sh']; const res = spawnSync(cmd, args, { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(res.status || 0);"
